title: Prominent public functions at national level, at the level of International Organisations and at the level of the European Union Institutions and Bodies

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: heads of State, heads of government, ministers, deputy ministers and state secretaries; in Austria, this concerns in particular the Federal President, the Federal Chancellor and the members of the Federal Government and the provincial governments

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: members of parliament or of similar legislative bodies; in Austria, this concerns in particular the members of the lower house (Nationalrat) and the upper house (Bundesrat) of the Austrian parliament

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: members of the governing bodies of political parties; in Austria, this concerns in particular members of the governing bodies of political parties represented in the Nationalrat

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: members of supreme courts, of constitutional courts or of other high-level judicial bodies, the decisions of which are not subject to further appeal, except in exceptional circumstances; in Austria, this concerns in particular judges of the Supreme Court, the Constitutional Court and the Supreme Administrative Court

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: members of courts of auditors or of the boards of central banks; in Austria, this concerns in particular the President of the Federal Court of Auditors, the directors of the provincial courts of auditors and members of the board of directors of the National Bank of Austria

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: ambassadors, chargés d’affaires and high-ranking officers in the armed forces; in Austria, high-ranking officers in the armed forces include military personnel above the rank of Lieutenant General

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: members of the administrative, management or supervisory bodies of State-owned enterprises; in Austria, this applies in particular to undertakings in which the Federal Government holds at least 50 % of the ordinary share capital, principal capital or equity capital, or which the Federal Government operates alone or which the Federal Government effectively controls through financial or other economic or organisational measures; the board of directors or the management of enterprises in which a province owns 50 % or more of its ordinary share capital, principal capital or equity capital, or which a province operates alone or which a province effectively controls through financial or other economic or organisational measures, provided that the total annual turnover of such an enterprise exceeds EUR 1 000 000. Total annual turnover is determined on the basis of the annual revenue from the most recent annual accounts

functions.heading: Politically exposed person: a natural person exercising or having exercised prominent public functions. This includes in particular
functions.function: directors, deputy directors and members of the board or equivalent function of an international organisation
